summary: Runtime verification completed. Found and fixed a bug: buildGoalSummary() in agent-executor.ts hardcoded channel: 'telegram' (15-line limit) instead of 'cli' (unlimited) for CLI output. Fix committed (5640d0fe8). Verified via CLI goal run: (1) goal completes successfully, (2) fail-open behavior works correctly when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is absent (falls back to 'Top Steps'), (3) when manual tests are present, formatCompactGoalCompletionSummary renders numbered tests with [X/10 Critical] suffix (verified via unit tests — 52/52 pass). (4) Telegram path is unaffected (uses its own buildDoneSummaryWithManualTests with channel: 'telegram'). (5) Gateway process has ANTHROPIC_API_KEY set, so generateManualTests() will succeed for Telegram-initiated goals. (6) Run artifacts persist correctly: manualTests, telegramDoneMessage, telegramFeedbackPromptMessages all survive sessionToSerialized round-trips (verified via run-store tests). (7) buildGoalDoneInlineKeyboard produces correct gTD/gIF callback buttons. (8) Callback handlers route correctly to formatManualTestDetails (gTD) and feedback prompt (gIF). (9) Old runs without new fields deserialize cleanly (all fields optional). Note: full end-to-end Telegram button interaction requires the gateway to be restarted to pick up the channel fix, then a goal must complete via Telegram to exercise the manual tests + button flow.
